summary.text: On Theros the gods blame mortals for Xenagos's ascension and swear vengeance, so Elspeth flees into the wilderness, where she is reunited with Ajani and they swear to set things right.
Supported by Ajani, Elspeth travels to Nyx and kills Xenagos, but Heliod, afraid of her power, fatally wounds her with her own weapon.
Elsewhere on the plane, mortals face Nyxborn attacks and the dreams of Ashiok, while heroes like Zosimos learn that a true hero is concerned with what he leaves behind.
